question: The year is 2022. I am at the National Air and Space Museum east of the Potomac River. I want to go to Fire Station 301 DCA ARFF using the metro. I go in the wrong direction and end up at the station closest to Cleveland Elementary School. How many metro stations am I away from my original destination if I don't change lines? Your answer should be a numerical integer value.

history.name: WashingtonDCMetroNavigation_Expert
history.content: Plan: Identify the museum's nearest station (likely L'Enfant Plaza), confirm the destination as the Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport station (serving Fire Station 301 DCA ARFF), determine the station nearest to Cleveland Elementary School, and count Yellow Line stations to the airport without changing lines. UrbanMapping_Expert, please confirm the exact nearest station to Cleveland Elementary School to avoid transfers.

history.name: UrbanMapping_Expert
history.content: Cleveland Elementary School is at 8th St NW & T St NW, DC. The closest Metro station by walking distance is U Street/African-Amer Civil War Memorial/Cardozo. Starting point near the museum is L'Enfant Plaza. Destination is Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport station. If the rider heads the wrong way northbound, U Street is a plausible arrival without changing lines on Yellow.

history.name: TransitRouteVerification_Expert
history.content: Yellow Line sequence from U Street southbound to Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport (excluding the starting station): Shaw-Howard University (1), Mt Vernon Sq/7th St-Convention Center (2), Gallery Place (3), Archives-Navy Memorial-Penn Quarter (4), L'Enfant Plaza (5), Pentagon (6), Pentagon City (7), Crystal City (8), Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport (9). Without changing lines, that is 9 stations.
